name: data-governance
description: Private owner repository for the DPM logical data definition and extraction boundary

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/openapi-projection-contract build && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/dpm build
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/openapi-projection-contract test && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/dpm test
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/openapi-projection-contract typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/dpm typecheck
scripts.smoke:dpm: corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/dpm smoke:subpaths && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/dpm smoke:extraction && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/dpm smoke:consumer-workflow && corepack pnpm --filter @oa-sdk/dpm smoke:pack
